blocks.prompt: 16. If \(a, 2a + 2, 3a + 3, \ldots\) are in G.P., then find the fifth term.
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein terms ek anjaane number \(a\) mein diye gaye hain.
Diya kya hai? \(a, 2a + 2, 3a + 3\) G.P. mein hain.
Find kya karna hai? Paanchwan term.
Plan: G.P. ki sharait (beech wale ka square = pehla \(\times\) teesra) se \(a\) ki equation, us ko solve karna, ghalat value ko rad (reject) karna, phir \(r\) aur \(a_5\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a, 2a + 2, 3a + 3\) G.P. mein hain.
Humein find karna hai: 5th term.
Tareeqa: Pehle \(a\) nikalna zaroori hai, kyunke us ke baghair terms ki value maloom nahi. Phir \(r\) aur \(a_5 = a_1 r^4\).

G.P. ki sharait lagayein
\[(2a + 2)^2 = a(3a + 3)\]
\[4(a + 1)^2 = 3a(a + 1)\]
Kyun: Teen terms G.P. mein hon to beech wale ka square pehle aur teesre ke product ke barabar hota hai. \(2a + 2 = 2(a + 1)\) aur \(3a + 3 = 3(a + 1)\) likhne se common factor \((a + 1)\) saaf nazar aa gaya.

\((a + 1)\) ko cancel kiye baghair solve karein
\[(a + 1)\left[4(a + 1) - 3a\right] = 0\]
\[(a + 1)(a + 4) = 0\]
\[a = -1 \text{ or } a = -4\]
Kyun: Sab kuch ek taraf la kar \((a + 1)\) common liya. Andar \(4a + 4 - 3a = a + 4\) bacha.
Dhyan dein: Dono taraf \((a + 1)\) se divide kar dena aam ghalti hai; is se \(a = -1\) wala hal ghayab ho jata hai. Pehle sab hal nikaliye, phir check kar ke faisla kijiye.

\(a = -1\) ko check karein
\[-1,\ 0,\ 0\]
Kyun: \(a = -1\) rakhne se terms \(-1, 0, 0\) bante hain. G.P. mein koi term zero nahi ho sakta, kyunke phir ratio \(\frac{0}{0}\) banta hai jis ka koi matlab nahi. Is liye \(a = -1\) rad (reject).

5th term nikalein
\[a_5 = a_1 r^4 = -4\left(\dfrac{3}{2}\right)^4\]
\[= -4 \cdot \dfrac{81}{16} = -\dfrac{81}{4}\]
Kyun: \(n = 5\) ke liye power 4. \(\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)^4 = \frac{81}{16}\), aur \(-4 \times \frac{81}{16}\) mein 4 aur 16 ko chhota karne se \(\frac{1}{4}\) bacha.

Tasdeeq: list aage barhayein
\[-4,\ -6,\ -9,\ -\tfrac{27}{2},\ -\tfrac{81}{4}\]
Kyun: Har dafa \(\frac{3}{2}\) se multiply karne par bhi paanchwan term \(-\frac{81}{4}\) aaya. Formula aur list mutfiq hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(-\frac{81}{4}\) number \"15\" ke saamne likha hai. Asal mein yeh isi sawal (kitab ka Sawal 16) ka jawab hai; lagta hai key ne 14 wala khala chhor kar numbers ginay. Kitab ka Sawal 15 proof hai aur us ka koi jawab key mein nahi. Value \(a_5 = -\frac{81}{4}\) khud bilkul sahi hai.
